body:
weight: light
tier: 1
charter: C2

specs/factory-step3-v1/SPEC.md row TB6. A kept lock is never heartbeated, so a PR held more than 24 h is rebuilt by a second node, and the kept lock eats a slot so the janitor kills the node's next claim.

Closes the pre-spec simulation gaps node:G3, node:G12, node:G13, node:G14, merge:G8a, merge:G8b, merge:G8c, merge:G9, intake:I2, intake:I12 (ids are `<segment>:<id>` rows of specs/factory-step3-v1/records/sim/<segment>.md, re-checked in specs/factory-step3-v1/records/TB0.md).

Deliverables:
- When run.sh opens the PR it releases the claim lock (the PR is now the claim) and labels the Issue `in-review`.
- mirror.sh never labels `ready` while an open PR exists for the branch prefix `ticket/<id>/`; claim.sh skips such a ticket; the janitor leaves locks whose PR is open out of both the TTL and the slot count, and releases any lock whose Issue is closed.
- A new owned label `blocked` replaces `needs-desk` when the only reasons are dependency order (wave > 1 or an open parent); the digest and summoner ignore `blocked`. `Depends-on:` lines in the Issue body carry the link, `Depends-on: T21 (#2)`.
- run.sh checks it still owns the lock (heartbeat.sh dry run) before it pushes, else `lock-lost`; a `pr-open-failed` is retried on the next iteration from a state file, then released to the desk; the per-ticket `budget` from `adlc ticket show` overrides the weights.
- Ruling recorded: the forecast's serial order stands; the merge-queue hold is defense in depth, because adlc lets a child complete before its parent.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A PR held past 24 h is not rebuilt, and a held PR does not cause an over-slots release. Verify: `bash tests/test_janitor.sh` and `make sim`.
2. A dependency-only wait is `blocked`, any other reason is `needs-desk`, and the Issue body links the parent. Verify: `bash tests/test_mirror.sh`.
3. claim.sh skips a ticket with an open PR. Verify: `bash tests/test_claim.sh`.
4. lock-lost, pr-open retry and the budget override behave as described. Verify: `bash tests/test_run.sh`.
5. Every new or changed script is shellcheck -S warning clean and every workflow passes actionlint. Verify: `make lint`.
6. The whole offline suite passes, including the simulation. Verify: `make test` and `make sim`.

Out of scope: any write to GitHub (no push, PR, label, ruleset or secret; I1); editing anything under factory/policy/ (I15: a change there is a desk note in the spec's HANDOFF); editing other tickets.
title: Release the claim when the PR opens, keep held PRs from being rebuilt, and add the blocked label
